candidates.explanation: The duplicate-email check is inverted. It throws emailExists only when the user found by the new email is the current user (`userByEmail.id === currentUser.id`). That can't happen here, because the new email differs from the current one. When the email belongs to a different account, the check passes. The code then signs a confirmation hash and sends the mail, and the request returns 200 instead of 422.

fix.description: Change the condition to `userByEmail && userByEmail.id !== currentUser.id`, or simply `if (userByEmail)`, so that an email owned by another account triggers the 422 emailExists error.

candidates.explanation: The duplicate-email check is inverted. It throws emailExists only when the user found by the new email is the current user (`userByEmail.id === currentUser.id`). That can't happen here, because the new email differs from the current one. When the email belongs to a different account, the check passes. The code then signs a confirmation hash and sends the mail, and the request returns 200 instead of 422.

fix.description: Change the condition to `userByEmail && userByEmail.id !== currentUser.id`, or simply `if (userByEmail)`, so that an email owned by another account triggers the 422 emailExists error.
